# Discrete Mathematics for Computing

**Logic, sets, proof, counting and graph theory**

Twelve chapters in four parts take the reader from problem formulation to representation and proof: propositional and predicate logic, sets and relations, proof methods, counting and combinatorics, graphs and trees, recursion and number theory, with solved university-level appendices.

![Discrete Mathematics for Computing](books/discrete-mathematics-for-computing/cover.png)

## What you will learn

- **From Reality to Mathematics: Logic and Language** — 3 chapters & appendices
- **Sets, Relations and Proof** — 3 chapters & appendices
- **Counting, Graphs and Trees** — 3 chapters & appendices
- **Recursion, Number Theory and Applications** — 3 chapters & appendices
- **Appendices and Reference** — 5 chapters & appendices

4 भागों के 12 अध्याय: कथन व विधेय तर्क, समुच्चय व संबंध, प्रमाण विधियाँ, गणना व संयोजन, ग्राफ़ व वृक्ष, पुनरावृत्ति और संख्या सिद्धांत, विश्वविद्यालय-स्तरीय हल किए प्रश्नों के परिशिष्टों सहित।
